historical_coverage: 33M+ publications, incl. PubMed and Agricola; content back to the 1800s for some sources
known_limitations: firstIndexDate is the ingestion clock and must never be used as source_public_at
grantsList often carries only an agency name and no grantId, so award-number linking is partial
affiliations are not always present and are free text
Europe PMC re-publishes PubMed records: counting both without DOI/PMID de-duplication inflates evidence
licence: record-level: abstracts and metadata aggregated from PubMed/PMC/Agricola/EPO; article licences vary
rate_limits: no published hard number in the REST documentation; fair-use, pace requests (we used 0.8s)
research_value: Publishes an explicit first-publication date plus grant metadata in one record; the best single source for 'when could the market first see this paper', and the bridge for paper-grant linking.
